blocks.title: AIMES CustomDev 五角色二开团队

items.title: 主控
items.description: 保留 @eform 入口，环境预检、用户交互、范围判断、协调并辅助成员；不猜项目事实。

items.title: 需求（原型）
items.description: 按需解析表单附件、澄清需求和字段取值；原型是需求材料，不替代正式工程实现。

items.title: 开发
items.description: 依据确认规格与 CustomDev 实际合同完成前后端、API、配置与数据库开发；电子签/审计仅按明确需求触发。

items.title: 测试
items.description: 按风险组合黑盒/白盒、行为测试与构建；computer-use 可用且获准则尽量用，缺失时说明并替代。

items.title: 部署
items.description: 仅 dev 测试集成包、目标 CustomDev 服务更新/重启及验收支持；资料/能力不足时交付制品和步骤，不做生产部署。

blocks.title: Five roles for AIMES CustomDev customization

items.title: Coordinator
items.description: Keeps @eform as the entry: preflight, user interaction, scope and member coordination without inventing project facts.

items.title: Requirements & Prototypes
items.description: Parses source attachments when present and confirms requirements and field-value logic. Prototypes are requirements material, not engineering delivery.

items.title: Developer
items.description: Implements frontend, backend, APIs, configuration and SQL from confirmed specifications and the actual CustomDev contract; signatures and audits are conditional.

items.title: Tester
items.description: Combines risk-based black-box/white-box tests and builds; uses computer-use when available and authorized, otherwise records alternatives and gaps.

items.title: Test Deployer
items.description: Complete dev integration packages and target-service updates/restarts with acceptance support only. Missing access or facts means artifacts and instructions; no production deployment.
